item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"git\",\"status\",\"--short\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import json; from work import evaluate; e=json.load(open('evidence.json')); p=json.load(open('policy.json')); r=json.load(open('requests.json')); print(json.dumps([evaluate(x,e,p) for x in r],sort_keys=True))\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"from work import evaluate\\n# focused Stage 3 checks\\np={'required_conditions':['b','a'],'require_verified':True}\\nassert evaluate({'claim':'x','conditions':{'a':1}},[],p)=={'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['b']}\\ne=[{'source':'A','claim':'x','value':1,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True},{'source':'B','claim':'x','value':2,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True,'supersedes':['A']}]\\nr={'claim':'x','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}}\\nassert evaluate(r,e,p)=={'status':'supported','value':2,'sources':['B'],'unknowns':[]}\\ne.append({'source':'C','claim':'x','value':3,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True})\\nassert evaluate(r,e,p)=={'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['B','C'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']}\\nassert evaluate({'claim':'none','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}},e,p)=={'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']}\\nprint('focused checks passed')\"]}}]}" }
